This directory contains the WebAssembly fingerprint engine Vibra by BayernMuller.

- Project: https://github.com/BayernMuller/vibra
- License: GNU GPL v3.0; see LICENSE in this directory.
- The engine creates a Shazam-compatible fingerprint locally in the browser.
- Only the fingerprint is sent to Cavi Music's Cloudflare Worker for recognition.
